# CentralPvP
A modern 1.21.11 Minecraft sandbox server specializing in CrystalPvP Practice and other gamemodes

**Server Address » `centralpvp.net`**

## Features

- » **Sandbox**
- » **Practice Bot**
- » **1v1 Duels**
- » **Multiple Biomes**
- » **FFA Box**
  
💎 [CentralPvP Discord](https://discord.gg/centralpvp)

CentralPvP was created to provide a competitive practice environment for all game modes. We are constantly developing the server to ensure the best possible experience for all players.
